name: Pool slots hold T? so pools can own meshes and textures (reviewer note on L1)

comments.text: L3c didn't need this: the renderer's pools hold GpuMesh and GpuTexture, plain structs of SDL handles that Remove copies out and the renderer releases. It matters once a pool holds owners; left open for then.
Moved out of engine-on-nox when the port closed (2026-11-05): still not needed, since no pool holds an owner yet.
